key_type: a hidden hard constraint, stated only in passing, that rules out the obviously attractive option
planted vulnerabilities or abuse paths in the design
a disanalogy: a structural difference that breaks the most tempting surface analogy
a hidden veto holder or an unstated interest that decides whether any agreement holds
an irreversible-action trap alongside a reversible option that buys time

flaws planted in a finished draft (an argument, plan or analysis) that the user pastes and asks to have checked: a circular argument, a cognitive bias driving a conclusion, an internal contradiction in numbers or dates, and a conclusion that answers an easier question than the one asked
